ci.yml.trigger_block:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings

p8-runtime.yml.trigger_block:
name: P8 runtime observations

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'Cargo.*'
      - 'scripts/p8_runtime*.py'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_p8_runtime*.py'
      - 'scripts/p8_backfill.py'
      - 'scripts/p8_resources.py'
      - 'scripts/p7_build_identity.py'
      - 'scripts/p7_stdio_build_receipt.py'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_p8_backfill.py'
      - 'scripts/p8_cold_build.py'
      - 'scripts/p8_rollback.py'
      - 'scripts/resource_harness/**'
      - '.github/workflows/p8-runtime.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'

p8-scale.yml.trigger_block:
name: P8 complete scale measurements

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
  RUSTFLAGS: ""

p8-platform.yml.trigger_block:
name: P8 platform cold builds

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"

p8-lifecycle.yml.trigger_block:
name: P8 lifecycle and resource observations

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: p8-lifecycle-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

p8-gates.yml.trigger_block:
name: P8 original failure gates

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'crates/**'
      - 'Cargo.*'
      - 'scripts/p8_gate_controls.py'
      - 'scripts/p8_recovery.py'
      - 'scripts/p8_cold_build.py'
      - 'scripts/p8_rollback.py'
      - 'scripts/p7_build_identity.py'
      - '.github/workflows/p8-gates.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

p7-engineering.yml.trigger_block:
name: P7 engineering regressions

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
  CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
  RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings

p7-closeout.yml.trigger_block:
name: P7 closeout evidence

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
  CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
  RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
